build_marching_cubes_mesh: build a triangular mesh from a 3D SDF tensor using marching cubes and return a trimesh object
create_mesh_from_sdf: create a cleaned and colored mesh from an SDF tensor with optional normal or height coloring
draw_camera_markers: draw a camera frustum marker in a trimesh scene given a camera object and 4x4 transform matrix
visualize_point_clouds: transform and visualize a batch of camera-space point clouds into world coordinates with optional image colors
draw_xyz_axis_overlay: draw a colored XYZ axis overlay on an image using camera intrinsics and an object-to-camera transform
